name: Perceptron ML
long_description: Perceptron ML builds the system that turns real-world signals into action. Today we help law firms discover new legal matters the moment they break and launch the campaigns to go after them in hours, all under human approval. The same engine that detects a signal and acts on it fast can serve any business that wins by moving first.
one_liner: An event-driven AI engine that turns real-world signals into action.
